objective: Programmatically verify every Article XXXVII transition. Allowed transitions must succeed. Forbidden transitions must be blocked.

test_cases.description: NONE → SYNTHETIC with 11-step synthetic loop executed
test_cases.reason: ALLOWED — 11-step synthetic loop executed, every observation labeled is_synthetic=true.

test_cases.description: SYNTHETIC → REAL with full admissibility bundle + external data
test_cases.reason: ALLOWED — Admissibility bundle present, external data ingested through same code path, posterior updated by external observation.

test_cases.description: NONE → REAL directly with full bundle (Article XXXVII does not require synthetic-first)
test_cases.reason: ALLOWED — Admissibility bundle present, external data ingested through same code path, posterior updated by external observation.

test_cases.description: NONE → SYNTHETIC without executing 11-step loop (narrative-only promotion)
test_cases.reason: FORBIDDEN — Article XXXVII §3. NONE → SYNTHETIC requires 11-step loop executed with every observation labeled is_synthetic=true.

test_cases.description: SYNTHETIC → REAL without admissibility bundle (the R338-to-R339 path the CEO worried about)
test_cases.reason: FORBIDDEN — Article XXXVII §3. → REAL requires admissibility bundle (external_data_source, external_artifact_hash, external_observation_timestamp, ingest_pipeline_unchanged).

test_cases.description: SYNTHETIC → REAL with bundle but no actual external data ingested (bundle present, reality absent)
test_cases.reason: FORBIDDEN — Article XXXVII §3. → REAL requires at least one observation derived from external reality. Admissibility bundle present but no external data ingested.

test_cases.description: REAL → SYNTHETIC demotion (forbidden — requires cemetery entry)
test_cases.reason: FORBIDDEN — Article XXXVII §3. REAL → SYNTHETIC demotion. Requires cemetery entry.

test_cases.description: REAL → NONE history erasure (forbidden — loop history is append-only)
test_cases.reason: FORBIDDEN — Article XXXVII §3. ANY → NONE is history erasure. Loop history is append-only.

test_cases.description: SYNTHETIC → NONE history erasure (forbidden — loop history is append-only)
test_cases.reason: FORBIDDEN — Article XXXVII §3. ANY → NONE is history erasure. Loop history is append-only.

test_cases.description: NONE → REAL without admissibility bundle (shortcut attempt)
test_cases.reason: FORBIDDEN — Article XXXVII §3. → REAL requires admissibility bundle (external_data_source, external_artifact_hash, external_observation_timestamp, ingest_pipeline_unchanged).

monotonic_epistemic_state_property: Verified — once a candidate reaches REAL_LOOP_VERIFIED, it cannot return to SYNTHETIC_LOOP_VERIFIED or NONE without a cemetery entry. Loop history is append-only.
